title: View of the Nordenskiöldbreen glacier from Пирамида-Pyramiden.jpg
author: Joxean Koret
description: View of the Nordenskiöldbreen glacier from Пирамида/Pyramiden, in Svalbard. In the picture, you can see the bust of Lenin at the left, the main square of Pyramiden as well as the aforementioned glacier in the back.
